subject: gov.legislate
name: Cybercrime bill overhauling the 2014 law
milestone: Put to a plenary vote 4 September 2026
position_end: Bill n. 042/2026 went before the National Assembly for a vote on 4 September 2026. It creates a digital protection and investigation unit as a public establishment with legal personality and financial autonomy, charged with prevention, detection, technical investigation, operational coordination and support to judicial authorities; article 75 gives that unit direct, permanent technical access, twenty-four hours a day and seven days a week, to the information systems of electronic communications operators, internet service providers and other bodies holding data needed for investigations, covering identification, subscription and traffic data and, under conditions, content. Article 17 provides two to five years' imprisonment and fines of 5,000,000 to 50,000,000 ariary for knowingly creating, organising, running or taking part in a coordinated information-manipulation network using fake or automated accounts, and for deceiving a person by means of a fake account or identity to obtain funds or property; the text also makes group administrators and users who knowingly reshare manifestly illicit content responsible

subject: dpi.registry

subject: dpi.registry

position_end: Not implemented; the only in-window addressing development is a community-built mobile layer with no legal standing (2026-07)

subject: dpi.registry
name: Orinasa online business registration platform
milestone: Regional antenna opened in the Sava region, July 2026
position_start: Established by decret n 2024-1911 with the paper procedure preserved where the platform is not deployed (2024-11)

subject: dpi.registry
name: Registre Social Unique (RSU)
milestone: 2.6 million households registered by May 2026, ahead of the June target
position_end: 2.6 million households registered, exceeding the ministry's 2.5 million June 2026 target early, with registration continuing in 99 districts to December 2026 (2026-05)

subject: dpi.registry

subject: dpi.mis

position_end: 55.6 per cent, level 2 of the maturity scale, across national, sub-national and facility levels

subject: dpi.mis

subject: dpi.mis

subject: dpi.mis

subject: dpi.govtech

subject: dpi.govtech
